name: People Enrichment
description: Enriches a person's information, the more information you pass in, the more likely we can find a match. [See the documentation](https://apolloio.github.io/apollo-api-docs/?shell#people-enrichment)

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: The full name of the person

configurable_props.name: hashedEmail
configurable_props.label: Hashed Email
configurable_props.description: The hashed email of the person. The email should adhere to either the MD5 or SHA-256 hash format. Example: `8d935115b9ff4489f2d1f9249503cadf` (MD5) or `97817c0c49994eb500ad0a5e7e2d8aed51977b26424d508f66e4e8887746a152` (SHA-256)

configurable_props.name: domain
configurable_props.label: Domain
configurable_props.description: The domain name for the person's employer. This can be the current employer or a previous employer. Do not include `www.`, the `@` symbol, or similar. Example: `apollo.io` or `microsoft.com`

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: The Apollo ID for the person

configurable_props.name: linkedinUrl
configurable_props.label: LinkedIn URL
configurable_props.description: The URL for the person's LinkedIn profile

configurable_props.name: revealPersonalEmails
configurable_props.label: Reveal Personal Emails
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` if you want to enrich the person's data with personal emails

configurable_props.name: revealPhoneNumber
configurable_props.label: Reveal Phone Number
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` if you want to enrich the person's data with all available phone numbers, including mobile phone numbers
